rationale: The description states conventional address verification, standardization, formatting, validation, and casing functions, with no affirmative AI/ML signal.
evidence_spans: The Spectrum Universal Addressing Module is powerful enough to handle all of your address verification and standardization needs. Capable of verifying addresses in more than 220 countries in real-time situations, it can automatically recognize data by country, and can even confirm primary house numbers and apartment numbers.

The address verification software ensures that your data is correctly formatted and validated, and can handle multi-national characters and apply casing so you can personalize your marketing communications.
